answer: Bind each agent key to a carrier-verified mobile SIM: every epoch the network texts a one-time signal to that number and the agent must sign it back within a minute. Hashed numbers sit in a shared registry, so keys answering from one SIM, eSIM profile or VoIP range merge into a single reward share. Growing an orchard of 1,000 fake keys means leasing 1,000 postpaid lines billed monthly, real timber paid per tree instead of free seeds.
